quote_zh: 向2L三口烧瓶加入的2‑氯‑3‑(2 ,2 ,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯231 .9g，1 ,2‑二氯乙烷1L，15℃搅拌。缓慢加入氯化亚砜237 .9g。常温反应0.5h，升温至75℃，保温3h。中控检测原料含量≤0.2％，在‑0.098mP下减压脱溶至85℃，脱去溶剂以及过量的氯化亚砜。
arithmetic_check: THIS SECTION IS THE ONLY ONE IN THE DOCUMENT THAT CARRIES QUANTITIES, so it is the only one on which anything can be checked. Every figure below is computed from the masses as printed; the patent computes none of them and states no mole, no equivalent and no yield anywhere. Molecular weights used: the benzoyl chloride C11H9Cl2F3O4S 365.15, the corresponding benzoic acid C11H10ClF3O5S 346.70, thionyl chloride 118.97. PRINTED: 231.9 g of the benzoyl chloride, printed '231 .9g' with a space before the decimal point, and 237.9 g of thionyl chloride, printed '237 .9g'. IMPLIED MOLES: 231.9 / 365.15 = 0.6351 mol of the benzoyl chloride as named. 237.9 / 118.97 = 1.9997 mol of thionyl chloride, which is 2.000 mol to four figures, so the thionyl chloride charge is a round two moles. DOES IT CLOSE? NO, AND THIS IS THE STEP THAT FAILS. 2.000 mol of thionyl chloride is 3.149 equivalents against 0.6351 mol of the compound the paragraph names, and that compound is the acid chloride: it has no hydroxyl for the thionyl chloride to substitute, so on the printed reading the entire 237.9 g is charged onto a substrate that cannot consume it and is then stripped off again as 'the excess'. The charge is not merely redundant, it is threefold. THE SAME NUMBERS AGAINST THE OTHER READING. If the charged material is really the benzoic acid, as [0009] and the [0031] drawing both have it, then 231.9 / 346.70 = 0.6689 mol and the thionyl chloride is 1.9997 / 0.6689 = 2.990 equivalents, that is 3.00 equivalents to three figures: a designed, routine excess for an acid-to-acid-chloride conversion. The printed masses therefore fit the acid to within 0.3% of a round three equivalents and fit the named acid chloride at no round number at all. That is arithmetic evidence bearing on the contradiction and it is recorded as evidence only; the artifact keeps the name the patent prints and does not substitute the acid. NOT CHECKABLE HERE: this step states no product mass, so no theoretical-yield or mass-balance reconciliation is possible on the step itself; that check is done on Step 3 and it closes. The flag raised is mass_balance_implausible, used deliberately for a stoichiometric charge rather than for a product mass exceeding theory, because the closed list has no value for the latter; the record's notes say so. UNIT DEFECT on this step: the reduced pressure is printed '-0.098mP', which is not a pressure unit. MPa is plainly meant. Recorded as printed, not converted, and conditions.pressure left not_specified because the strip is a workup operation.

quote_zh: 重新加入新的1,2‑二氯乙烷500ml和三乙胺200g，投入1,3环己二酮92g和丙酮氰醇0.5g，40℃保温6h。检测反应完全。过滤出三乙胺盐，减压浓缩得红棕色固体环磺酮产品，
arithmetic_check: Molecular weights used: the benzoyl chloride 365.15, cyclohexane-1,3-dione C6H8O2 112.13, triethylamine C6H15N 101.19, acetone cyanohydrin C4H7NO 85.11. PRINTED: 500 ml of fresh 1,2-dichloroethane, printed with the locant as '1,2', 200 g of triethylamine, 92 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 0.5 g of acetone cyanohydrin. This step restates no mass for its substrate, which is Step 1's stripped residue from 231.9 g, that is 0.6351 mol of the compound as named. IMPLIED MOLES: 92 / 112.13 = 0.8205 mol of the dione. 200 / 101.19 = 1.9764 mol of triethylamine, again close to a round two moles. 0.5 / 85.11 = 0.00588 mol of acetone cyanohydrin. THE DIONE IS IN EXCESS, NOT DEFICIT: 0.8205 / 0.6351 = 1.292 equivalents against the acyl chloride as named, or 0.8205 / 0.6689 = 1.227 equivalents against the acid reading. Either way the acyl chloride is the limiting reagent and the dione is charged some 23 to 29% over it. TRIETHYLAMINE: 1.9764 / 0.6351 = 3.112 equivalents against the acyl chloride, or 2.955 against the acid reading, and 2.409 equivalents against the dione. The ester formation liberates one equivalent of hydrogen chloride per acyl chloride, so a threefold charge of the acid acceptor is a generous excess but not an inconsistency. Note in passing that the printed triethylamine charge, like the printed thionyl chloride charge, is within a quarter of a percent of a round two moles, and that both are almost exactly three equivalents of the ACID reading rather than of the named acid chloride. ACETONE CYANOHYDRIN: 0.00588 / 0.6351 = 0.93 mol% of the limiting reagent, which is sub-stoichiometric and consistent with the catalyst role the shared identifier table assigns it. DOES IT CLOSE? YES, SAID EXPLICITLY RATHER THAN LEFT SILENT. Every charge in this step is a sensible multiple of the limiting reagent, no charge exceeds what its transformation can consume, and the step states no product mass, so there is nothing here that fails to close. No flag is raised on this record on arithmetic grounds. The only mass not checkable is the crude product's, because the patent gives it no mass; quantity.mmol and quantity.equivalents are null on every compound because the patent prints none of these figures and prompt rule 32 keeps computed numbers out of the record.

quote_zh: 环磺酮产品中加入40％含水甲醇，升温至60℃后加入5g活性炭保温1h，热过滤，搅拌转速调整为280转/h，控温滴加10％盐酸水溶液调节PH为2重结晶后降温析晶得淡黄色固体，烘干得262.1g环磺酮，含量95％。……目标产品环磺酮核磁参数如下：1HNMR(CDCl3)，δ2.12(m，2H)2.47(t，2H)，2.81(t，2H)，3.25(S，3H)，4.01(q，2H)，5.21(s，2H)，7.33(d，H)，8.12(d，H)，15.37(s，H)。
arithmetic_check: Molecular weights used: the benzoyl chloride 365.15, the corresponding benzoic acid 346.70, tembotrione C17H16ClF3O6S 440.82. PRINTED: 5 g of activated carbon, 40% aqueous methanol, 10% aqueous hydrochloric acid to PH 2, a stirring speed of 280 revolutions per hour, and 262.1 g of tembotrione at 95% content. No mass is printed for the crude charged into this step and no amount is printed for the methanol or the acid, so the recovery of the purification itself cannot be checked; what can be checked is the whole section, from the only input mass the patent prints to the only output mass it prints. IS 262.1 g AT 95% CONSISTENT WITH 231.9 g OF THE NAMED SUBSTRATE? YES, IT CLOSES, WITH ROOM TO SPARE. 231.9 g of the benzoyl chloride is 0.6351 mol, which at 440.82 g/mol could give at most 279.95 g of tembotrione at 100% content, or 294.69 g of a solid assaying 95%. The patent reports 262.1 g of solid, which is 93.6% of the 100%-content theoretical mass and well inside the 294.69 g ceiling, so no mass balance is violated. On active basis, 262.1 x 0.95 = 249.00 g, that is 0.5649 mol, an implied overall yield of 88.9% from the acyl chloride reading or 84.4% from the acid reading, both plausible and both below 100%. NO YIELD IS RECORDED FROM THIS. The patent states no yield percentage anywhere in the document, so product_yield_pct is null on all three records; the 88.9% and 84.4% figures exist only in this field, which is the provenance the A5 pass reads, and were not written into the artifact. SUMMARY ACROSS THE SECTION: Step 1 does NOT close, on the thionyl chloride charge, and carries mass_balance_implausible; Step 2 DOES close on every charge; Step 3 DOES close on the product mass. TWO DEFECTS ON THIS STEP THAT ARE NOT ARITHMETIC AND HAVE NO FLAG IN THE CLOSED LIST, recorded here so that the empty validation_flags on this record is not mistaken for a clean step. First, the stirring speed is printed 280 revolutions per hour while claim 3 and [0025] require 150 to 200 revolutions for this very step, so the document's only worked example of the invention falls outside its own dependent claim, and the claim's figure carries no per-time base at all, so the two are not even comparable units. Second, the PH is printed in capitals here and in the tables and lower case in the claims. Nothing was converted, adjusted or normalised, and conditions.stirring.rpm is left null rather than filled from a per-hour figure.
